name: Operational Intelligence
desc:
A whisper in the smoke, a choice made under a knife... 
War has never respected borders,
and the battlefield is never lacking in buried stories.

infoUnlockDatas.storyDesc:
A Rhodes Island operator is rescued by Scout. When he comes to, he happens to Hellagur speaking with Patriot.
Carrying the words Scout left him, the guard also makes up his mind.

W leads a team to intercept a group of defecting mercenaries. Flamebringer breaks through the conflict and leaves Reunion behind him.
At Rhodes Island, Flamebringer will meet another old friend...

Jessica completes her training under the guidance of Liskarm and Franka.
Her skills have always been excellent, but what she lacks is confidence.

The Laterano Notarial Hall deploys Executor, an undertaker, to carry out a commission in Siracusa.
Executor finds an uncooperative Vermeil there, and in accordance with the terms of the commission, takes her with him to Rhodes Island for treatment.

Ifrit and Projekt Red have another dispute over homework, resulting in Ifrit losing control of her emotions - and nearly her powers as well.
But with the help of those around her, she finally manages to regain control over herself.

An observatory in the North Pole is having some equipment abnormalities. To secure the way for future explorers, Magallan undertakes a risky maintenance mission.
However, Santalla, the operator who came to pick her up, is blocking her way.

infoUnlockDatas.storyName: Among the Light and the Dust
infoUnlockDatas.storyDesc:
A corridor in Rhodes Island experiences a power outage, and Closure invites Kal'tsit to check the circuitry with her.
Under Closure's guidance, even Kal'tsit would confide some of her inner thoughts.
